outline_measurement_coordinates: pixel centres on this crop from top left
glazing: Two casements on each opening. One fine muntin divides each leaf in two, and three cross rails divide its height into four. The overlight contains the four sides of a single central diamond, two side uprights and horizontal rails.
occlusion: Sparse branches conceal parts of the left sill, and a diagonal bamboo support crosses the rightmost lower sash. These positions follow the unobstructed central window; rear fixings were not measured.
colour_and_surface: The east photograph shows grey-green brickwork, warm red brick surrounds and two matching red horizontal bands. Distant tree shadows fall across the window glass.
physical_scale: 依据2024年8月19日东立面照片及同次校园踏查。窗外口的名义宽取1.10米，三窗中心间距约2.12米，绝对尺度、窗膛深度、木料截面和被花木遮住的两端窗下缘待现场实测。
